query: I tell the truth, but I say it so harshly that people feel agitated and hurt.
People on my team copy my behavior, so I need to set a good standard through my own actions.
I keep doubting the knowledge I study and cannot develop faith or inner peace.
I prefer extremely hot, salty, and pungent food even though it leaves me distressed and unwell.
I am proud of my status, expect respect, and struggle to behave with humility.
My mind is warm toward friends but hostile toward enemies; I want to treat both with balance.
I believe that simply refusing to do any work will free me from the consequences of action.
I try to meditate in crowded distracting places and cannot keep my mind controlled.
I want real knowledge, but I approach my teacher arrogantly instead of asking sincerely and serving.
When tempting objects appear, my senses immediately chase them; I need to withdraw and control them.
